title: Work It (TV series)
production_companies: Summer School ProductionsBonanza ProductionsWarner Bros. Television

premise_summary: Work It is an American television sitcom that aired on ABC from January 3 to January 10, 2012. Set in St. Louis, the series is about two men who must dress as women in order to keep a job in a bad economy.
